'''Poorfo''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who attempted to qualify to race in the [[Mon Gazza Speedway/Legends|Mon Gazza Maze]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the race, he tried to overtake [[Kidd Kareen]], but when Kidd made a maneuver, Poorfo was unable to respond before he was slammed into a wall and crashed near the starting line.
